text:
Maya Patel: Quick thread: toolbar alignment, "Save view" naming, and simplifying perf badges in the catalog compare. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-toolbar-2345.png
Nora Li: Toolbar should group view controls (save/share/dense) to the left of actions. Users keep missing the dense toggle on the right.
Diego Fernandez: Agreed. Also: change label from 'Save preset' to 'Save view' and include a short subtitle 'saves filters & sort'.
Kara Gomez: Accessibility notes: dense toggle must be a real button with aria-pressed and keyboard focus. If we move toolbar items, update tab order so keyboard flows left-to-right.
Maya Patel: Perf badge suggestion: replace multiple small percentile chips with one compact badge reading 'Perf p95' and an expander chevron. On focus/activate show p50/p95/p99 and trend. Avoid hover-only.
Nora Li: Also request: the badge should have an aria-label like 'p95 420ms, +18% vs baseline' for screenreaders.
Diego Fernandez: CSV snapshot/export: include a small metadata header with 'pin_scope' and 'p95_baseline' fields when users check 'Include metadata'. Default: metadata on.
Kara Gomez: Pin UX: when pinning from compare, show a one-line confirmation: 'Pin model to version vX? This applies model-wide.' Provide keyboard-confirmable actions and 'Don't show again' checkbox for power users.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Nora to update toolbar mock and copy (owner: Nora, due Tue)
- Diego to add CSV metadata header option to export modal + analytics event (owner: Diego, due Wed)
- Kara to run quick a11y pass on toolbar + badge interactions (owner: Kara, due Thu)
- Maya to consolidate mock and re-share when done
